axes.name: Weight
axes.description: Modulated by inverse fundamental frequency (80 Hz -> 900, 250 Hz -> 340).

axes.name: Width
axes.description: Modulated by pitch contour excursion and duration stretch; locked to 100 for Korean.

axes.name: Optical Size
axes.description: Optical point size tuning, scaled with crest scale.

axes.name: Slant
axes.description: Slant in counter-clockwise degrees (-10 for offscreen or sound effects).

axes.name: Grade
axes.description: Zero-reflow stroke density weight mapped from token prominence score.

axes.name: Extra Counter Width
axes.description: Internal counter width (widened to 520 when duration < 180ms for high-speed legibility).

axes.name: Opaque X
axes.description: Thick vertical stroke width modulated by vocal strain and affect.

axes.name: Opaque Y
axes.description: Thin horizontal stroke width modulated by vocal strain and affect.

axes.name: Ascender Height
axes.description: Ascender height (compressed toward 649 for crest scale > 1.35).

axes.name: Descender Depth
axes.description: Descender depth (compressed toward -98 for crest scale > 1.35).
